She is portrayed by {{jwp|佐藤江梨子|Eriko Sato}}. ==History== ===Pre-series=== Before having her current cafe, Masako had a restaurant in the district of {{wp|Ginza}}. She revealed that during that time, she was a very shy and naive person, but that changed when she needed to "change her skin". ===Season One=== In [[PPA01]], Masako saw Madoka Akagi alone while studying Pokémon's [[Type#Type_effectiveness|type advantage]]s. When asking Madoka about this, she made a correlation about the type advantages and the people each of them interacts with. ==Character== Masako is a young but very wise woman.
